# Switch NX2 - read when the Elysium GUI starts.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, the user copy (%APPDATA%\eden\nx2_switches.txt, or
# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/eden/nx2_switches.txt) wins over this one, so editing this file is never
# needed: copy the lines you want into your own and restart.
#
# Restart the emulator after editing.

# --- Performance tuning defaults for Switch 2 ---
# Offload GPU method/macro execution to the back thread (SPLIT=2 delivers up to +54% FPS alone).
EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=2

# Batch GPU fence syncpoints to reduce host driver overhead and smooth frametimes.
EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=1

# Leave buffer downloads disabled on Switch 2 (default): forcing downloads (=1) copies back
# 90-220 MB/s of buffers CPU never touches, causing heavy mutex contention and dropping FPS by ~38-63%.
#EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_DOWNLOADS=1

# Which fence the game waits for when it presents. 1 = the previous frame's: the game prepares the
# next frame while the GPU finishes this one, and waits for this one too while the GPU is behind.
# 0 = this frame's: no overlap. Any value other than 1 means 0, so =2 does not run two frames ahead.
# Unset: per title. Ocarina of Time uses 1, Donkey Kong Bananza 0, and other titles wait for this
# frame unless a GPU channel waits on a semaphore the game releases after the present.
# Ocarina of Time with =0 (or =2): 30.9 fps against 38.9 unset, same spot and settings.
#EDEN_NX2_FRAMES_AHEAD=1

# Hint uploaded texture guest memory cold every 600 frames (default on). Frizti measured
# skipping it worth 30.3 -> 35.1 fps on Ocarina of Time's 1% lows in Hyrule Field, on the
# grounds that a re-created image faults the memory back in while uploading. Measured here on
# Mario Kart World it goes the other way: skipping it took minor faults from 2,794/s to 6,829/s
# and 36.7 -> 34.0 fps, so the default stands and this is left for per-title testing.
#EDEN_NX2_TEXTURE_COLD_HINT=0

# Skip the guest-memory upload of a joined image that one of its join copies overwrites whole,
# and the alias copies before that one: enabled by default. Set to 0 to upload anyway.
#
# The earlier, looser version of this skip (enabled with =1) corrupted Ocarina of Time on a real
# display: text went missing from the main menu and Link's shadow intermittently became a square
# after ~193 skips, because its predicate called an image fully covered when it was not. The
# switch now turns the skip OFF rather than on, and the predicate is Lichii's
# CopiesWriteWholeImage, which reads the copies themselves after they are built and sorted: same
# 2D format, every level and layer from the origin, nothing rescaled, trimmed, sparse, unbacked
# or block-compressed. If the old symptoms come back, this is the switch to try.
#EDEN_NX2_COPY_SKIP=0

# Skip the guest-memory upload of a new image made entirely on pages a dropped GPU-written image
# left stale, where the buffer cache has not written them on the GPU since: enabled by default.
# Set to 0 to upload anyway. Ocarina of Time's render targets move address from frame to frame, so
# the cache keeps making new ones (~400 a second in Castle Town) and uploaded ~9 GB of stale bytes
# every 30 s. Same family as EDEN_NX2_COPY_SKIP above: if textures come out wrong, try both.
#EDEN_NX2_TC_SKIP_STALE=0
# --- Diagnostics (logging only, no behaviour change) ---
# Front-thread waits per drain site, in wall clock, with how much of each was parked.
#EDEN_NX2_WAIT_STATS=1
# How long the front spins before parking (default 16384). Parks are 0.1 per wait, so this
# trades spinning for parking and cannot shorten a wait.
#EDEN_NX2_SPIN_LIMIT=16384
# Vulkan submits, render passes and finish waits per second, without the zone profiler (which
# disables fast_maxwell3d and so cannot measure the path that ships).
#EDEN_NX2_SUBMIT_STATS=1
# Guest CPU reads of GPU-written memory: how often, and how long they block the guest thread.
# On Mario Kart World 70-144/s blocking 330-480 ms/s, in stalls of 3-5 ms.
#EDEN_NX2_READBACK_STATS=1

# --- Workarounds / Debug ---
# Terrain/indirect drawing fix for Donkey Kong Bananza: enabled by default. Set to 0 only to leave to GPU.
#EDEN_NX2_RESETFIX=0

# Drop reactive-flushing read traps on Switch 2 programs (opt-in; can reduce FPS from 29 to 24 in MKW).
#EDEN_NX2_NO_REACTIVE=1

# Keep the native global memory helpers as calls and route with one switch, rather than letting the
# driver inline a branch per candidate buffer at every access: enabled by default. Set to 0 to
# restore the old code (Ocarina of Time's foliage compute programs took NVIDIA's compiler 2.4 s
# each to build with it, 0.6 s this way).
#EDEN_NX2_LEAN_SSBO=0

# Drop decoded movie frames the sound has already passed, so a cutscene's picture keeps up with
# its audio below 60 fps: enabled by default. Set to 0 to hand out every frame, however late
# (Ocarina of Time's opening ran 30 s behind its audio at 48 fps without this).
#EDEN_NX2_VDEC_PACE=0

#EDEN_NX2_MME_JIT=0
#EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH=0
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_SAME=0
#EDEN_NX2_INLINE_DEFER=0
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_SKIP=1
#EDEN_NX2_AUTO_STUB=1
#EDEN_NX2_KEEP_ASTC=1
